places.name: Shut-through Near Side
places.description: A low roof carries wet soot above seven steps worn on their right edges. A rusted rail borders black water audible below. A square opening is crossed by newer wire, and a floor-level gap ends in packed ash. The far side remains uninspected and inaccessible.
